EP-M476T._provenance: Fully characterised on real hardware 2026-09-04 with the owner of a Japan-market EP-M476T (Reddit thread). CONFIRMED END TO END: read_key 0x364A found over the D4 control channel; a full 0-255 EEPROM dump matching the ET-4800 address layout exactly, with main_waste [48,49,47]/63.46 reading 100.11% on a printer that was in fact reporting end of life and addr 55 already holding 0x5E; and write_key Maribaya proven by a successful reset that read back clean on the first attempt. Arantifo (the other write key used by the 0x364A family) was the alternate candidate and was NOT needed. A no-op write probe could not distinguish the two, because this firmware answers OK to a write whose value already matches without checking the key - so the successful reset is the evidence, not that probe.
